rows._https_endpoint: Fixed-form URL text. Empty, non-ASCII and non-URL values return false before a request (test_copy_redirects_only_to_https_release_assets). JSON and port-body cases do not apply: the function does not decode JSON or accept a response body.
rows._load_stored_json: Stored JSON. Non-UTF-8, invalid JSON and a lone surrogate are typed BootstrapError before use (test_lock_rejects_non_utf8_before_use, test_lock_rejects_invalid_json_before_use, test_lock_json_rejects_lone_surrogates).
rows._reject_authorization_headers: Port answer: Authorization and Proxy-Authorization on the request raise BootstrapError before open. test_governed_copy_request_sends_no_authorization_header and the real-opener proxy tests apply. JSON decoding does not apply.
rows._reject_lone_surrogates: JSON text. Lone surrogates in nested values and keys, non-string keys, and NaN, Infinity and -Infinity raise BootstrapError (test_json_tree_rejects_non_string_key_and_non_finite_number, test_lock_json_rejects_lone_surrogates). A valid surrogate pair is not produced by the JSON decoder used here.
rows._transport_proxy: Fixed-form proxy text, including the authority form. The negative tests are test_real_opener_omits_proxy_authorization_for_an_authenticated_proxy and test_real_opener_omits_proxy_authorization_for_authority_proxy_forms. The function does not decode JSON.
rows._without_userinfo: Fixed-form proxy text. A non-text value raises BootstrapError before the split. Authority forms are covered by test_real_opener_omits_proxy_authorization_for_authority_proxy_forms.
rows.acquire: Port answer bytes and the lock JSON. A digest mismatch is not cached. Authorization is absent. Malformed lock JSON is rejected before any download (test_wrong_download_digest_is_not_retried_or_cached, test_governed_copy_request_sends_no_authorization_header, test_acquire_rejects_malformed_lock_before_download).
rows.build_ci_image: Port answer from Docker. A typed failure is returned and a bool budget never starts Docker (test_build_ci_image_reports_typed_docker_failure, test_build_ci_image_rejects_bool_budget_before_docker).
rows.build_context: Stored lock JSON consumed from acquire. A bool budget is rejected before Docker (test_build_ci_image_rejects_bool_budget_before_docker).
rows.cache_info: Stored provenance JSON reread from the cache file. The same UTF-8, surrogate and type rejects apply (test_cache_hit_provenance_rejects_non_utf8, test_cache_hit_provenance_rejects_lone_surrogate).
rows.checked_sha512: Fixed-form SHA-512 digest. Empty, non-ASCII, uppercase and non-string values are rejected before use (test_lock_digest_form_is_rejected_before_use, test_checked_sha512_rejects_non_string_expected_before_read).
rows.final_url_allowed: Fixed-form final URL. A final host outside release-assets is rejected (test_copy_final_url_outside_release_assets_is_rejected).
rows.main: CLI timeout and the lock file. A non-finite timeout and a malformed lock are rejected before acquisition (test_main_execute_rejects_non_finite_timeout, test_main_check_rejects_malformed_lock).
rows.official_url: Fixed-form source URL. The same redirect tests reject a non-HTTPS or foreign host before use. No JSON object is decoded here.
rows.redirect_allowed: Fixed-form redirect URL. Non-HTTPS and non-release-assets hosts are false before the next request (test_copy_redirects_only_to_https_release_assets).
rows.release_asset_url: Fixed-form governed-copy URL. test_governed_copy_is_the_only_download_when_bytes_match uses the constant. A malformed copy URL is not requested.
rows.remaining: Finite budget number. A bool and a non-finite timeout are rejected before a download (test_budget_rejects_bool_before_any_download, test_budget_rejects_non_finite_numbers). No digest is parsed here.
rows.urlopen: Port answer and fixed-form request URL. Authorization headers are rejected first. The opener strips proxy credentials. Body decoding is not done here.
